description: Policy-driven market events and their trading implications
context: User asking how to trade around major policy announcements (macro, industry regulation, etc.).
user_input_examples: 降息降准对A股有什么影响？
行业出新政策了，相关股票怎么操作？

structure.current_status: Policy event summary and initial market reaction
structure.risks: Policy expectation gap and sell-on-news risk

key_principles: Buy on rumor, sell on news: if stock already rallied 20%+ before policy confirmation, it's priced in
Distinguish structural policy (long-term sector reform) from cyclical policy (short-term stimulus)
First-day reaction often overdone; wait 1-2 days for consolidation before entering
Policy beneficiaries: direct (core business impacted) > indirect (supply chain) > sentiment (concept stocks)
Duration of impact: monetary policy ~3-6 months, fiscal policy ~6-12 months, regulation ~indefinite

decision_tree.if_policy_announced_and_stock_not_rallie: Buy the initial reaction, set trailing stop
decision_tree.if_stock_already_rallied_20pct_before_po: Sell into strength, policy is priced in
decision_tree.if_policy_negative_for_sector: Immediate 50% position reduction, wait for dust to settle
